description: Create a shared basket with the items AND the customer's contact and delivery details (and delivery date), and get a link. The customer opens it on any device, lands on our checkout with everything filled in, reviews it and pays. Use check_delivery first for valid dates. For graded units the same rule as basket_link applies: show grade, condition notes and photos first, then set condition_shown_to_customer. Only use the customer's real details, with their agreement.

comment.description: Delivery instructions, e.g. access or parking

condition_shown_to_customer.description: Required true when graded_ids is used

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, one of the dates check_delivery offers

name: create_basket
title: Create a ready-to-pay basket
